dataList.content:
Gah, haah, oh man...
哈、哈……哎呦喂。

Whew... seriously, the stairwell is the real challenge, isn't it? Not the Kurokumo Clan guys.
这……敌人不强，但爬楼梯反而更累人欸？！

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
Curious... is it not?
不觉得……这很奇怪吗？

Huh? What is?
嗯？什么啊。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
That they filled the stairwell full of weaklings who clearly don't know what they're doing.
这里不尽是些糊里糊涂的家伙吗。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
Perhaps they weren't trying to stop us from going upstairs. Perhaps they were afraid of retreating upstairs...
他们好似不是为了挡住我们才堵在这里的，而是不想去往楼上……

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
... No, it can't be.
……难道。

Aeng-du's expression darkened.
樱桃的脸蒙上了一层阴霾。

Maybe she had an inkling of a bad omen...
难道是预想到了什么不好的事情吗。

Dost thou... worry for thy mentor?
汝很担忧……那位头领吗？

Don Quixote carefully sidled to Aeng-du's side with a sympathetic expression.
堂吉诃德悄悄地接近樱桃，垂下眉毛，担忧地问道。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
... How could I not?
……怎能不忧心呢。

What kind of person was Mr... Uh, Bamboo-hatted Kim?
那位金笠……是一位怎样的人？

Aeng-du appeared conflicted, as though she was having trouble organizing her own thoughts. She shook her head and sighed.
樱桃像是还没有整理好思绪，摇了摇头，叹了口气，随即说道。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
He was... a steadfast man.
他是个威风凛然的人。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
Protected what needed protecting, killed what needed killing.
守护应守之物，斩杀当斩之敌。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
He was always one of the Blade Lineage's finest. I daresay that he was one of the most skilled swordsmen within the Lineage.
实力能与其比肩之人，在剑契组内部也屈指可数。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
A man of few words who always sought to take good care of those under his wings.
而且，虽然少言寡语，但对自己组里的人总是悉心照料。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
... If only he hadn't made that decision...
……若非那个决定。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
... my fellows would not have met such a terrible fate...
我的友人们也不会落入此等窘境……

Sinclair half-opened his mouth, apparently curious about what that 'decision' might have been,
辛克莱看上去很在意那个决定是什么……

but he soon realized that this was probably not the time to pry and quietly closed his mouth.
但似乎很快察觉到现在并非询问的好时候，便安静地闭上了嘴。

dataList.title:
Blade Lineage
剑契组
dataList.content:
Whichever may be the case, I have no choice but to make haste...
无论情况如何，也只能赶紧上楼了……

Then... we have no choice but to make haste with her.
那……我们也只得追上去了。
